fsi.source: DCPR 2034, Reg. 30(1), Table 12 (Suburbs / Extended Suburbs base Zonal FSI)
fsi.notes: On roads < 9m in suburbs, only base Zonal FSI is permitted; no additional premium FSI or TDR is granted.
Base FSI 1.0 + max 0.50 Premium FSI + max 0.50 TDR on roads >= 9m and < 12m.
Base FSI 1.0 + max 0.50 Premium FSI + max 0.70 TDR on roads >= 12m and < 18m.

island_city_base_fsi.notes: Base Zonal FSI for Island City is 1.33; most self-build independent plots are in Suburban Mumbai.

fsi.premium_fsi_note: Premium FSI is subject to payment of premium at 50% of Ready Reckoner Rate (RRR) per DCPR 2034 Reg 30(2). TDR utilization must adhere to Regulation 32.

front.notes: Relaxed front marginal space for congested / small residential layouts where road width < 9m.

side.notes: May be built up to boundary with dead wall on one side subject to neighbour consent / CFO norms.

rear.notes: Minimum rear open space for low-rise structures up to 10m height.

front.notes: Standard 3.0m front marginal distance from access street boundary.

side.notes: Side open space for residential buildings up to 10m height (G+2).

rear.notes: Rear open space for residential buildings up to 10m height on plots <= 250 sqm.

front.notes: Front marginal space on roads >= 9m to 12m for plots > 250 sqm.

side.notes: Side open space for low-rise residential on plots > 250 sqm.

rear.notes: Rear open space for low-rise residential on plots > 250 sqm.

max_height.notes: Permissible height for G+2 residential without requiring mid-rise fire installations or high-rise CFO approvals (cap <= 10m on road < 9m).

max_floors_note: Typically Ground + 2 upper floors (G+2) or Stilt + 2 floors within 10m total building height for single-family residential.

ground_coverage.source: DCPR 2034, Reg. 41 & Reg. 42 (Derived effective coverage after mandatory marginal open spaces)
ground_coverage.notes: DCPR 2034 does not prescribe a flat percentage for small plots; coverage is governed by setbacks, resulting in ~50-60% buildable footprint.

habitable_area_m2.notes: Minimum carpet area for any habitable room (approx 102.25 sqft).

habitable_min_width_m.notes: Minimum clear width of habitable room (approx 7 ft 10 in).

habitable_other_area_m2.notes: Where a dwelling has two or more habitable rooms, one must meet habitable_area_m2 and the others may be 7.5 m2 (approx 80.7 sqft).

habitable_other_min_width_m.notes: Minimum width of the second and further habitable rooms.

kitchen_area_m2.notes: Minimum kitchen area where separate dining is provided (approx 59.2 sqft). Minimum width 1.8m.

toilet_area_m2.notes: Minimum combined bath and WC area (approx 28.0 sqft). For independent WC: 1.1 sqm; independent bath: 1.5 sqm.

ceiling_height_m.notes: Minimum clear height from finished floor to ceiling soffit in habitable rooms. For bath/WC: minimum 2.2m.

window_to_floor_ratio.notes: Total unobstructed window/ventilator area opening directly to open air must be >= 10% of floor area, with at least 50% openable.

main.source: NBC 2016 Part 4 / Part 3 Clause 4.12 & DCPR 2034 Reg. 37(18)
main.notes: Minimum clear doorway opening width for main entrance door. Height >= 2000 mm.

habitable.notes: Minimum clear width for internal habitable bedroom doors. Height >= 2000 mm.

toilet.notes: Minimum clear width for bathroom and water closet doors. Height >= 2000 mm.

min_width_m.notes: Minimum width of interior staircase for single-family residential low-rise.

max_riser_mm.notes: Maximum riser height for residential stairs.

min_tread_mm.notes: Minimum tread width without nosing for residential stairs.

car_spaces_per_tenement.source: DCPR 2034, Reg. 44, Table 21 (Residential tenement > 100 sqm carpet area)
car_spaces_per_tenement.notes: Tenements <= 100 sqm require 1 scooter/two-wheeler space; tenements > 100 sqm require 1 car parking space (2.5m x 5.0m).

car_stall_size_m.notes: Minimum clear dimensions of car parking bay.

min_column_mm.notes: Minimum lateral dimension of reinforced concrete column for earthquake-resistant framing in Seismic Zone III.

span_depth_ratio.source: IS 456:2000, Cl. 23.2.1 (Basic ratio is 20 for simply supported; 16 provides conservative deflection control)
span_depth_ratio.notes: Effective span-to-depth thumb rule for deflection limit states under residential live loading.

seismic_zone_factor.source: IS 1893 (Part 1):2016, Table 3 & Annex E (Mumbai is Zone III)
seismic_zone_factor.notes: Zone III seismic peak ground acceleration factor Z = 0.16.

basic_wind_speed_ms.source: IS 875 (Part 3):2015, Appendix A (Basic wind speed Vb for Mumbai)
basic_wind_speed_ms.notes: Design peak gust wind speed for 50-year return period.

drainage_slope.source: IS 1742:1992, Cl. 4.3 (Code of practice for building drainage)
drainage_slope.notes: Self-cleansing velocity gradient for 100mm underground soil/waste pipes.

soil_bearing_kn_m2.source: Conservative presumptive safe bearing capacity for shallow foundations in Mumbai weathered basalt / clay strata (IS 1904:1986 Table 1)
soil_bearing_kn_m2.notes: Varies drastically across Mumbai: hard basalt in eastern suburbs reaches 250+ kN/m2; reclaimed coastal mud requires pile foundations.

annual_rainfall_mm.source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) / MCGM Disaster Management Cell normal annual rainfall for Santacruz / Colaba
annual_rainfall_mm.notes: Intense tropical monsoon rainfall occurs predominantly between June and September.

crz_and_special_zones_note: If a plot falls within CRZ-II (Coastal Regulation Zone, within 500m of HTL on landward side of existing road/structure), construction is governed by MoEFCC CRZ Notification 2011/2019 and MCZMA approval is mandatory, with FSI capped to pre-2011 norms. Plots near defense installations, civil aerodromes (AAI CCZM height restrictions around CSMIA and Juhu), or Grade I/II/III Heritage precincts (DCPR Reg. 52) require separate NOCs.
approval_checklist: Property Card (PR Card) / CTS extract from Superintendent of Land Records (dated within 3 months)
DP Remark (Development Plan 2034 zoning certificate from MCGM Chief Engineer DP)
City Survey demarcation map / CTSO boundary demarcation certificate
Advocate 30-year Search Report and Clear Title Certificate
AutoDCR / BPAMS digital architectural submission by an MCGM-registered Licensed Surveyor / Architect (CoA registered)
Structural Stability Certificate and design drawings by an MCGM-registered Structural Engineer
Geotechnical Soil Investigation Report from an accredited materials testing laboratory
Drainage and Water Supply remarks from MCGM Hydraulic Engineer and Sewerage Department
Tree Authority NOC (or Tree Officer tree preservation/transplantation undertaking)
CFO (Chief Fire Officer) Self-Declaration / NOC for residential building <= 15m height
Receipt of Scrutiny Fees, Development Charges, and Labour Cess payments
Intimation of Disapproval (IOD) issuance and compliance with 40+ standard pre-construction conditions
Commencement Certificate (CC) issued by MCGM Executive Engineer (BP) prior to any ground excavation
